devops.title: Git Rebase vs Merge
devops.body:
Saat update branch:
- `git merge` — history berantakan, tapi preserve konteks
- `git rebase` — history linear, cocok untuk feature branches
- `git rebase --interactive` — squashing commits sebelum merge ke main

Tip: gunakan `git log --graph --oneline --all` untuk visualisasi.

performance.title: OPcache for PHP
performance.body:
Untuk production, enable OPcache di `php.ini`:
```ini
opcache.enable=1
opcache.memory_consumption=128
opcache.max_accelerated_files=7963
opcache.revalidate_freq=60
opcache.fast_shutdown=1
```

random.title: Git: Recover Deleted Branch
random.body:
Cabang terhapus bisa dikembalikan via reflog:
```bash
git reflog | grep 'checkout:.*[branch_name]'
git checkout -b recovered_branch
```

system_design.title: Database Indexing Strategy
system_design.body:
Index kolom yang sering di-WHERE clause, tapi jangan berlebihan:
- ✅ WHERE, JOIN, ORDER BY columns
- ✅ Unique constraints
- ❌ Too many indexes slows write
- ❌ Index low-cardinality columns (bool, gender) — pakai partial index

Gunakan `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` untuk profiling query.

database.title: Redis vs Cache Database
database.body:
Redis bukan pengganti database — gunakan untuk:
1. Session storage (with TTL)
2. Cache layer (read-through pattern)
3. Rate limiting
4. Job queue (Redis Queue)
5. Leaderboard (sorted sets)

Strategi: cache-aside pattern
```python
# Read
data = redis.get(key)
if not data:
    data = db.query(...)
    redis.setex(key, 3600, data)
```

docker.title: Docker Layer Optimization
docker.body:
Susun Dockerfile dengan yang paling sering berubah di paling bawah:
```dockerfile
# Least change — base image, deps, config
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production

# More change — app code
COPY . .
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
```

api.title: REST API Error Format
api.body:
Gunakan HTTP status code yang tepat:
- 200 — GET, PUT, PATCH (success)
- 201 — POST (created)
- 204 — DELETE (no content)
- 400 — Bad request
- 401 — Unauthorized
- 403 — Forbidden
- 404 — Not found
- 409 — Conflict
- 429 — Too many requests

Response body:
```json
{"error": "user_not_found", "message": "User ID 123 not found", "code": 404}
```

testing.title: Test Pyramid — Unit > Integration > E2E
testing.body:
Fokus pada rasio:
- 🔺 70% Unit Tests
- 🔺 20% Integration Tests
- 🔺 10% End-to-End Tests

Unit test: cepat, isolated. Integration test: test interaksi module. E2E: test full flow (slow, flaky).

random2.title: Git: Cherry-pick Specific Commit
random2.body:
Ambil commit tertentu dari branch lain:
```bash
git checkout main
git cherry-pick abc1234  # commit hash dari feature branch
```
Berguna untuk backport fix ke production branch.
